recommendation: Keep the empty no-change audit commit as-is; no follow-up source work is needed for FHIR-12336 unless a separate, final tracker asks to change the Duration invariant wording.
issue_request: FHIR-12336 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core datatypes change request raised against DSTU2. It asked to fix the datatype examples page's Timing duration example, "TID, for 14 days", because the boundsDuration XML showed a second unit element after system where it should have shown code.
initial_application: The Jira comments record svn revision 11205 as the application. In the git-svn history, commit c999ceec6362b8d87f983f22d770cff82ea5bfe7 corresponds to build@11205 and changed source/datatypes-examples.html from <unit value="d" /> to <code value="d" /> in that exact boundsDuration example. Later datatype example refactoring, including FHIR-19608's JSON-example addition, preserved the corrected code element.
additional_context: The current source/fhir.ini type-page configuration keeps datatype pages in the build, and source/datatypes.html links to datatypes-examples.html. The current source/datatypes-examples.html Timing example still says "TID, for 14 days" and now has both XML and JSON surfaces using code "d" after the UCUM system. The duplicate Jira comment about drt-1 did not become a separate final request on this issue, and no Zulip or Confluence evidence was found that changes the example-fix conclusion.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The authoritative current source for the reported example is already corrected, and a source-wide pattern scan did not find the reported invalid system-followed-by-unit form.
